title: RMD vs WLS
summary: The Resto Shaman holds three answers — fewer than anyone on either team. Everything here is about reaching him through the Warrior.

sections.title: Kill the Shaman, and count the Warrior's eight before you commit
sections.body: Counts: Warrior 8, Lock 4, Shaman 3. The Shaman is thin by a wide margin — Spirit Link, Astral Shift, trinket, and that is the list. The Warrior's eight are why you cannot simply train him instead: Die by the Sword is 30% of all damage taken for 8s, not a parry effect, and Rallying Cry blunts the whole go rather than saving one player.
